title: Water parameter (parameters/items/<id>/parameter.json)
description: A water chemistry or physical parameter the ecosystem can track, from a sensor or from a manual test. The folder name is the id and, for a dosed parameter, matches the supplement effects parameter so the two catalogs line up.

name.description: Human label shown on the card (e.g. 'Alkalinity').

symbol.description: Short label as printed on the test kit (e.g. 'KH', 'NO3').

category.description: Grouping used to lay the parameters out on the card.

decimals.description: Digits shown after the decimal point.

device_class.description: Home Assistant sensor device_class a matching sensor is expected to carry, used to auto-map a sensor to this parameter.

sources.description: Where a value for this parameter can come from.

effect_parameter.description: The supplement effects parameter this maps to, when a supplement can raise it. Lets the card tie a dosing head to the parameter it drives.

range.description: Reef-keeping reference band, used for the target gauge and the out-of-range colour. Every bound is optional; give only the ones that are well established.

min.description: Lowest value the scale starts at (not a target).

max.description: Highest value the scale ends at (not a target).

low.description: Below this the parameter reads low.

high.description: Above this the parameter reads high.

source.description: Where the reference band comes from (program, label, URL).
